items.title: Browne Jacobson warns on cyber insurance gaps and AI liability risks
items.summary: Legal experts highlight that treating cyber policies as a simple tick-box exercise and integrating custom AI tools are driving fresh insurance disputes.

items.title: The Pensions Regulator finds wide governance gap between small and large schemes
items.summary: Research published by The Pensions Regulator reveals that only 27% of small defined contribution schemes have formal governance arrangements.

items.title: Aon expands 2027 Aon Client Treaty follow facility to 35% capacity
items.summary: Aon has renewed and expanded its Aon Client Treaty follow facility for 2027, increasing pre-secured Lloyd's co-insurance capacity from 28.5% to 35%.

items.title: Specialty insurance growth tests lasting capacity amid softening market rates
items.summary: Specialty insurance expansion faces questions over long-term capacity as financial and professional lines rates soften globally.

items.title: Australian watchdog targets UK-linked Petcover over policy terms
items.summary: Australian consumer group CHOICE has criticised pet insurer Petcover over policy renewal terms that reset pre-existing conditions annually, highlighting contract structures that share similarities with UK time-limited products.

items.title: Government maintains auto-enrolment earning thresholds for 2027/28
items.summary: The government has confirmed following its annual review that auto-enrolment earnings triggers and limits will remain unchanged.
